ABOUT CASPIAN SHIELD

Built around
your peace of mind.

Security Caspian Shield Ltd provides security services for people, properties, venues and events. Our services bring together on-site guarding, mobile patrols, door supervision, event security and construction site security.

Every environment is different. We start by understanding your priorities, then discuss the coverage, responsibilities and communication your security plan needs.
